inspections.scope: Read complete helper and exact candidate boundary. Pre/post clean Git status and all nine SHA256 pins, serial 39-case list, exact unfiltered TAP totals, full npm run lint and existing single warning, distinct fresh logs/results, no production writes.

Read same full helper again against task resource/ownership instructions. Cloud Linux only; command-specific deadlines; owned process group termination only on exceptional command timeout; source fixtures own detached test children; full lint uses384MiB Node heap to avoid exhausting restored sandbox. Any failure stays failed with retained phase result; the passed39 cases are not repeated if lint later needs hosted resources.

cleanup: Preserve evidence through acceptance and durable Git retention; future agents remove only owned temporary output/worktrees after integration.
